title: County Arrest Records
author: Inaya Ahmed
description:
Welcome to County Arrest Records, your educational podcast for understanding public arrest records, county booking information, jail rosters, inmate lookup resources, and court records across the United States.
In each episode, we explore how county arrest records work, where to find publicly available information, and how to identify official sources for reliable research. Learn about arrest logs, booking reports, custody information, sheriff's office records, detention facilities, and public records access.
Our podcast covers county-specific arrest records and public information resources across Alabama and other states. We discuss topics such as searching arrest records by name, understanding jail rosters, locating official county resources, and distinguishing arrest records from criminal convictions and court case outcomes.
Whether you're researching your own public records, learning about county booking procedures, or looking for information about a particular jurisdiction, County Arrest Records provides straightforward explanations to help you understand the process.
Explore episodes covering local topics, including Coffee County Alabama Arrest Records, Clarke County Alabama Arrest Records, and Chambers County Alabama Arrest Records.
We also explain why verifying records matters, how public information can become outdated, and why official sources should be consulted before relying on important details.
Our mission is to make public records information easier to understand while encouraging accurate, responsible research. An arrest does not establish guilt, and charges or case outcomes may change. Always verify important information with the appropriate official agency. Everyone is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.
Follow County Arrest Records for educational discussions about county arrest records, booking information, inmate searches, jail rosters, and public records resources throughout America.

title: Episode 26.84 - GSM Minorities
author: Dr. Diana Sorrentino, Ph.D.
description:
Today’s Podcast:
Paradoxes of Gender Episode 26.84
Exploring the Issues & Challenges Facing Gender & Sexual Minority Individuals.  

Episode 26.85 
Guest:  Dr. Christine Hartigan, Psy.D., CAADC  

Paradoxes of Gender Podcasts:
The Paradoxes of Gender Podcasts are Designed to Deliver Professional Development Educational Programs for the LGBTQ+ Medical & Behavioral Healthcare Providers who provide Medical & Behavioral Healthcare Services to Transgender, Gender Diverse, Gender Non-Conforming, Gender Incongruent and Non-Binary Individuals.  

Prepared & Presented by:
Dr. Diana Sorrentino, Ph.D. Social-Psychologist & Behavioral Analyst  

Delivering comprehensive Medical or Behavioral Healthcare Services as a component of your practice on behalf of Transgender (TG), Gender Diverse (GD) Individuals and members of the LGBTQ+ Community may at times prove to be a little challenging. The challenges you may experience have historically been caused by a lack of specialized medical or behavioral health training you received in preparation for your career and the care you will be providing for Transgender and Gender Diverse patients.   

This understanding was underscored and reinforced by a 2011 study, reported in the Journal of the American Medical Association, the medical schools, on average, only provide Five (5) hours of academic or clinical instruction on LGBTQ+ healthcare requirements.  In the absence of specialized training; time is required to acquire first-hand real-world knowledge and experience with the diverse challenges, needs and experiences these individuals present and what they are confronted with as they live their lives in their Self-Attributed Non-Conforming Gender roles.  

Transgender, Gender Diverse, Gender Non-Conforming, Gender Incongruent & Non-Binary individuals, their families, friends, schools, employers and social-networks will also benefit from the content of these Podcasts in-spite of the fact that the detailed medical and psychological content of these programs focuses on the continuing educational needs and requirements of the medical or behavioral healthcare professional.  Knowledge is essential to counteract the negative publicity and the political hyperbole disseminated by individuals with no understanding of the history and underlying biological factors influencing gender non-conformity.    

Dr. Sorrentino is a Member of:
the World Professional Association for Transgender Health

title: The Labyrinth - A Novella
author: Friedrich Gatzen
description:
The Labyrinth: A Novella

"The sand isn't golden. It is pale and ashy, like bone bleached by centuries of sun. White. Vast. Without edges."

"The Labyrinth" is a haunting novella set in a bone-white desert of heat and absolute exposure. It explores the profound relief—and the devastating cost—of being radically witnessed.

When a solitary traveller steps through a wall-less doorway in the desert, they find a timeless, faceless presence waiting in the shadow. Suspended between them is a single crimson silk thread pulsing with the raw, unfiltered memories of humanity's ancient threshold-keepers: a Palaeolithic cave painter, a Delphic Oracle, an Egyptian priest, the mystic Hildegard, and a Norse Völva.


The cosmic thread stretches to its absolute breaking point during the spiritual awakening of Siddhartha Gautama. When the prince's mind completely unclenches into the absolute zero of Nirvana, the waiting shadow lunges down the silk line to consume the emptiness—triggering a catastrophic implosion that shatters the doorway into a literal mirage..

No cinematic scores. No synthetic sound effects. Only a solitary voice guiding you down into the warm center of the void.


Close your eyes and let the current carry you.


Listening Note: To experience the intended narrative flow and depth, listeners are highly encouraged to listen in chronological order (starting with Episode 1) and to use headphones.

Both have worked in leadership and consulting positions across a range of industries, giving them unparalleled insights into the inner workings of successful businesses. Their combined experience has allowed them to develop market-leading perspectives on the common pitfalls and opportunities that businesses face, and they share this wisdom with listeners on every episode.Beyond their impressive credentials, Gruder and Tuzinkewich imbue the Boosting Business Value podcast with humor, warmth, and authenticity, making each episode feel like a conversation with trusted mentors who understand what it takes to succeed in business. This approach helps to make the podcast accessible to a broad range of listeners, from first-time entrepreneurs to seasoned business owners and executives, as well as business purchasers and trusted advisors.Listeners can expect to learn a great deal from the Boosting Business Value podcast. Each episode is packed with practical perspectives and actionable steps on a stunningly broad range of challenges that can be applied to a wide range of businesses, regardless of their industry or size. This makes the Boosting Business Value podcast a one-stop-shop for anyone seeking to create successful value acceleration and a profitable exit for their business.One of the best things about the Boosting Business Value podcast is the depth of resources available to listeners. In addition to the podcast itself, listeners can access a range of valuable resources through the Blue Sky Business Resources website, including free assessment tools and a variety of resources to assist through the full business lifecycle. These resources complement the podcast's advice, offering listeners a more in-depth understanding of the challenges and opportunities facing their business.For entrepreneurs and business owners looking to create value acceleration and a successful exit strategy, the Boosting Business Value podcast is a must-listen. With Dr. David Gruder and Jason Tuzinkewich at the helm, listeners can expect to gain the knowledge, skills, and resources they need to succeed in any industry. From mitigating risks to increasing operational efficiency to dealing with psychological factors in business, Gruder and Tuzinkewich offer an unmatched level of expertise and insight. Business owners and entrepreneurs looking to take their companies to the next level should visit https:///www.BlueSkyAdvisors.net/podcast to access all episodes and learn more about Blue Sky Business Resources' full-lifecycle business advisory services.

title: The Vintage Passport
author: Noah Tetzner
description:
The Vintage Passport is a weekly wine podcast hosted by historian and wine collector Noah Tetzner. Each episode explores the history and culture behind the world’s great wines through conversations with leading wine historians, authors, and scientists.  
Travel from the vineyards of Burgundy, Bordeaux, and Champagne to California, Italy, Australia, and across the world. Step into the cellars where French winemakers hid their treasures from the Nazis during World War II, and go back thousands of years to the search for where grapevines were first domesticated. Discover how wars, revolutions, trade, religion, and science shaped the wines we drink today, and why every bottle carries a story worth telling.  
Whether you’re a curious wine lover, a history buff, a sommelier, or someone who simply enjoys a good glass with a good story, The Vintage Passport is your guide to the history of wine, famous wine regions, grape varieties, and the people who made them matter.  
New episodes every week. Pour a glass, press play, and follow The Vintage Passport wherever you listen to podcasts.

title: History of Economic Species
author: Ken Earon
description:
Every science has a mirror. Step in front of economics' and you'll see a very particular kind of human staring back.

Who is he? Where did he come from? And what does the way economists see us tell us about the world we live in?

History of Economic Species is a narrative documentary podcast about the economic image of the human being — how it was invented, how it has changed, and why it matters.

Over two centuries, economists have understood human behaviour in radically different ways. Each version of the economic man — Homo Economicus — was shaped by the politics, science, and ideological conflicts of its time. And with each version, the policies governing our lives changed too.

This podcast tells that story. Not as a textbook. As a journey through the personalities, rivalries, and intellectual battles that built the discipline whose assumptions we all live inside today.

Hosted by Ken Earon — educator, independent scholar, and PhD in the history and philosophy of science — History of Economic Species brings the history of economic thought to anyone who has ever wondered: do economists understand people? And if not, what are the consequences?

title: Scary Postpartum Thoughts with Arielle Wozniak
author: Arielle

What if I hurt my baby? What if I lose control? Why am I having these horrible thoughts when I love my baby so much?


If scary, unwanted thoughts have left you questioning yourself, your faith, or your ability to be a good mom, this podcast is for you.


Scary Postpartum Thoughts with Arielle Wozniak is a faith-centered podcast for moms struggling with postpartum OCD, intrusive thoughts, and the fear that something is terribly wrong with them.

Arielle, founder of Peace After Postpartum, shares her lived experience with postpartum OCD, honest conversations about the thoughts women are often afraid to say out loud, and practical insights into the patterns that can keep OCD going, including reassurance-seeking, checking, avoidance, and mental compulsions.


Through short, relatable episodes, you'll explore what postpartum OCD can look like, how it intersects with motherhood and Christian faith, and what it means to move toward peace without needing absolute certainty.


You don't have to keep navigating scary postpartum thoughts in silence.


New episodes twice a week.

description:
In November 1994, Sydney woman Revelle Balmain disappeared after attending what was believed to be her final appointment of the day. More than three decades later, her disappearance remains one of Australia’s most enduring mysteries. 
In Revelle Balmain: The Last Appointment, we revisit the final hours before she vanished and speak with people who knew her best  including former boyfriends, her stepsister Sue-Ellen, and one of the last people known to have seen Revelle alive.
Through their memories, new interviews and a fresh examination of the case, the series explores who Revelle was, what was happening in her life at the time, and the unanswered questions that remain about her disappearance.

The Thread of Christ

Stories of Saints, Miracles, and the Unseen Presence that Weaves Through Every Age

Across centuries, continents, and lives, there runs a single luminous thread: the living presence of Christ moving unmistakably through human history.

The Thread of Christ is a storytelling podcast that traces the divine filament through the lives of Saints, the Mysteries of Miracles, and the luminous interventions of Guardian Angels.

Each episode reveals a moment when Heaven touched Earth: a Saint who embodied the Grace of God, a miracle that defied every earthly explanation, an Angelic encounter that altered the course of a life.

Some legends feel distant in our modern world, but each moment of Christ’s love on Earth resonates with the heart of humanity, alive today in every way. These are the shimmering points along the thread that tie history to our common future.

Told with reverence, wonder, and a contemplative reflection, The Thread of Christ invites all to see the sacred pattern woven through humanity’s walk in Creation, while recognizing the ways that thread is still being stitched into our own stories.

If you feel drawn to the hidden, the holy, and the beautifully unexplained, this podcast is a lantern for the path. Come trace the thread. It has always been there. It is here now. And it continues forever.

description:
You know that weird moment when you get something you wanted and think...

Oh.

Wait.

I don't think I want this anymore.

Welcome to I Thought I Wanted This, the podcast about what happens when the life you planned and the life you actually want stop being the same thing.

I'm Katie Carson, and I have some experience with changing the plan. Careers. Relationships. Expectations. And, most recently, selling most of my stuff and moving to Italy.

This isn't a podcast about blowing up your life because TikTok told you to follow your dreams.

It's about asking better questions.

Do I actually want this? Or am I just good at it?

Would I choose this again? Or have I just been here so long that leaving feels impossible?

Is this an actual obstacle? Or something I've decided is an obstacle without ever testing it?

And if I do want something different... what would it actually take to make that happen?

We'll talk career changes, money, relationships, friendship, moving, starting over, doing big things on one income, and the thousand tiny decisions involved in building a life that fits the person you are now—not the person who made the original plan.

Just honest conversations, questionable decisions, practical plans, and one very important question:

What if you're allowed to change your mind?

description:
William Q. Judge dives deep into the mysteries of human existence in "The Ocean of Theosophy," unraveling complex concepts like reincarnation, karma, and after-death states. As he explores the seven natures of man, listeners will discover how these elements shape our spiritual journey. Judge doesn't just present theories; he warns against the pitfalls of pseudo-occultism, guiding seekers through the murky waters of misinformation. Each chapter acts like a lifebuoy, offering clarity on psychic phenomena and the roles of sages and adepts in our understanding of the universe.

This audiobook serves as a crucial companion for both newcomers and seasoned practitioners of Theosophy. With accessible language and engaging insights, Judge invites you to reflect on your own experiences and beliefs. What does it mean to evolve cyclically through existence? How do our past actions influence our present and future? These questions linger as you listen, sparking curiosity and self-exploration.

By blending philosophical depth with practical wisdom, "The Ocean of Theosophy" stands out as an essential resource for anyone eager to navigate the profound themes of life, death, and rebirth. Whether you're seeking to deepen your understanding or simply curious about Theosophy, this audiobook promises a thought-provoking journey that will resonate long after the final word.

description:
First, Do No Harm tells the true story of medicine. Each episode, host Nirob takes one turning point — the first vaccine, the doctor who discovered hand-washing and was ignored, the conquest of pain, the accident that became penicillin, a map that stopped a cholera outbreak, cells taken without consent that saved millions — and rebuilds it: the era, the people, the problem they faced, the discovery, and what it changed for the patients who came after.

From the days when surgery killed more often than it cured to the promise of gene therapy, First, Do No Harm is about the slow, brave, sometimes disastrous human effort to understand and heal the body — and about the patients and doctors whose lives that effort changed. Meticulously researched, honest about the failures and the ethics as well as the triumphs, and respectful of every patient. Clean and suitable for all ages. A new discovery every week

For some, I started including a strawberry jelly, banana, peanut butter, and chocolate sandwich in each improvised tale.

I decided to start recording them and sharing the joy with others, such as yourself.

One of my sons recently suggested that I read a Bible verse before each story. I embraced the idea and included the verses in the stories.

You may also come across adventure, compassion, humor, random acts of kindness, faith centered living, honor, healthiness, family time, and other positive elements served with your strawberry jelly, banana, peanut butter, chocolate sandwich in our series.

And don’t let my wife tell you otherwise but sometimes she also jumps in on the festivities of our storytelling!

In joy,
The Allens

title: Cuban Culture
author: karlat
description:
In my 10‑minute recording, I talk about five cultural words from Cuban and Hispanic culture, which is the culture I grew up in and the one that shapes my identity. The purpose of my recording is to help listeners understand important parts of Cuban life, traditions, and everyday experiences — especially for people who may have never heard these words before. Each word represents something meaningful in Cuban culture and shows how culture continues to influence us in the 21st century.The five words I chose are:
  1. Ropa Vieja – a traditional Cuban dish that represents family, history, and the reality of food scarcity in Cuba.
  2. Pregonero – a street vendor who sings and performs while selling items, showing the musical and expressive spirit of Cuban culture.
  3. Café Cubano (colado) – strong Cuban coffee that symbolizes community, daily rituals, and cultural connection.
  4. Quinceañera – the celebration of a girl’s fifteenth birthday, marking her transition into womanhood through symbolic traditions.
  5. Language (Cuban Spanish) – the unique slang, rhythm, and expressions Cubans use, showing how language reflects identity and cultural diversity.
Throughout the recording, I explain each word as if the listener has never heard it before. I share stories, examples, and cultural meaning behind each one. My goal is to show how Cuban culture contributes to cultural literacy in America today, and how understanding different cultural traditions helps us connect with one another.

  • Sadaka: Voluntary charity and acts of kindness, extending from monetary support to a warm smile or kind words.
  • L'Amana: Sacred trust, responsibility, and protecting what is placed in your care as a matter of personal honor.
  • Haqq Al-Jar: The mutual rights, care, and safety net among neighbors.

author: casder
description: We created the Selling Well podcast to help growth-oriented professional salespeople dramatically improve performance. We interview some of the top thought leaders in professional sales today to gather their best insights and teachings and we add them all to the Selling Well. Join us for this fun journey of lifelong learning in professional sales.

title: Leading Transformation
author: Dr. Petra Doerken and Uwe Doerken
description:
Leading Transformation is a podcast for enterprise leaders who want real results from AI, not the hype.
Hosts Dr. Petra Doerken and Uwe Doerken, former Chairman and CEO of DHL Worldwide, talk with industry operators, investors and technology executives about how they use AI, automation & operational intelligence to grow revenue, expand margins, increase throughput and build resilience. What it costs, what breaks, and what pays off.
New episodes every Wednesday.
Presented by D&D Legacy Capital, a family office investing in AI-native enterprise technology and global industry.

title: Franklin Planner Podcast
author: vfget
description: Are you ready to discover the keys to greater productivity and lead your life and team with principles that stand the test of time? Welcome to The Franklin Planner Podcast, your weekly guide to achieving your best life through proven strategies, timeless values, and expert insights. Whether you're looking for ways to boost your personal productivity, lead your team to new heights, or find lasting success, this podcast is your trusted companion on the path to intentional living.For more than 40 years, Franklin Planner has helped millions infuse their lives with meaning and clarity. Inspired by the principles of Dr. Stephen R. Covey and his groundbreaking work, The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People, this podcast builds on that enduring legacy. Hosted by Franklin Planner Board Member and Owner John Harding, alongside industry expert George Wright III, each episode dives deep into the essential habits, disciplines, and leadership principles that transform both individuals and teams.Together, John and George bring decades of experience, combined with interviews from accomplished business leaders, productivity experts, and success coaches, offering valuable lessons you can apply today. From overcoming roadblocks and staying focused on the "Big Rocks" in your life to fostering collaboration and trust in your team, the discussions are rich with actionable takeaways and practical wisdom.The Franklin Planner Podcast is more than a tool for learning; it’s an invitation to a community committed to growth, purpose, and intentional living. If you're ready to take charge of your time, lead with integrity, and craft a legacy of success, this is the podcast for you. Tune in weekly, and let's unlock your full potential—one timeless principle at a time.

title: Speak Goodr with Ryan Vet
author: Ryan Vet
description:
Not perfect. Just a little Goodr.


Speak Goodr with Ryan Vet is for speakers, authors, podcasters, and anyone with an idea worth sharing who wants to get better at sharing it. Your host is Ryan Vet, a generational futurist, keynote speaker, and two-time USA TODAY bestselling author. The show is built on his bestselling book Speak Goodr and his weekly Mic Drop newsletter.


Each episode gives you one practical lesson for your next stage, call, or camera: crafting a talk that sticks, growing your platform, and building a thought leadership practice that lasts. You'll hear Ryan's real stories from the road (the joke that fell flat, the delayed flight, the one person in the back row) along with conversations with speakers and thought leaders who are doing the work.


No perfection required. Show up, give it everything you've got, and be a little Goodr than last time. Inspire forward.

title: Making BIG Shifts
author: cfr
description: Making BIG Shifts is a growth and decision-making podcast for founders and operators, hosted by strategic integrator and founder of MKTG Reboot, Josh Anderson.  Each episode features real operators, founders, and leaders unpacking the hard parts of running a business, the tough decisions, the setbacks, the inflection points, and the wins that follow. Through founder stories, growth strategies, and startup strategy insights, conversations span growth, marketing, leadership, systems, and strategy, with a focus on the shifts that actually move businesses forward.

title: Career Sessions
author: fret
description: Career paths rarely unfold in a straight line. Some careers accelerate quickly, while others take unexpected turns, requiring us to adapt, reinvent ourselves, and seize new opportunities along the way. On Career Sessions, host J.R. Lowry sits down with accomplished leaders, entrepreneurs, academics, coaches, veterans, and professionals from all walks of life to explore the stories behind their careers. Through candid conversations, guests share the decisions, challenges, successes, setbacks, and lessons that shaped their professional journeys. Whether you're early in your career, navigating a transition, pursuing leadership opportunities, or simply looking for inspiration and practical advice, Career Sessions offers insights you can apply to your own path. Each episode goes beyond résumés and job titles to uncover how people build meaningful careers and thrive through change. J.R. Lowry has built a career across military service, management consulting, financial services, executive leadership, and entrepreneurship. Drawing on his own experiences and conversations with hundreds of guests, he helps listeners better understand the realities of career growth and the choices that can make the biggest difference over time.

title: Working Hard with Grace Beverley
author: fesdr
description:
In this top-charting podcast series, entrepreneur Grace Beverley breaks away from the conventional business podcast rhetoric - immersing us in the extraordinary journeys of people from all walks of life who have achieved remarkable success in unique fields. From housing campaigners to investors and sex experts, no avenue is off limits. Each conversation brings new lessons and stories that will inspire you to consider what ‘success’ really means to you and how you can achieve it.
Grace and her guests open up about the life lessons they wish they had known earlier, sharing insights from their entrepreneurial endeavours, offering advice on health and wellbeing, shedding light on pressing social issues, and being frank about the things that didn’t go quite right.
Think of it as a school of life. You’ll come away from each episode with actionable advice to help you achieve balance, success, and fulfilment whether you’re working hard, or hardly working.

title: From the Source with Wade Crowfoot
author: California Natural Resources Agency
description: Eight years. Historic wildfires, droughts, and an energy transition that has reshaped the fourth largest economy in the world. Now California Natural Resources Secretary Wade Crowfoot is pulling back the curtain. From the Source brings you unfiltered conversations with leaders across the Newsom Administration who have made the tough calls and consequential decisions that impact us all. No spin. No talking points. Just the truth behind California’s unfolding environmental story.

title: Truly Terrified: Paranormal vs. Physics
author: Truly Terrified
description:
Joe and Lin talk about all sorts of things. He’s a physicist and a mathematician while Lin is a little bit more, shall we say, woo.
 
Lin tells Joe stories of things she thinks are really strange, a little scary, or downright paranormal and he goes there, as far as his science brain can take him. 
Sometimes he has an explanation for how science can explain something, but other times he calls BS. And sometimes, just sometimes, Lin convinces him that there are things that defy explanation.
Come along and listen in to see if either of us will change your mind.

title: SabhFIT
author: SabhFIT Podcast
description: SabhFIT is a fitness podcast for busy people. I am here to make fitness easy for you so you can apply it in your everyday life. Through my workouts, I am committed to making fitness a habit for everyone by making it so much fun. This podcast is based on making the science behind your fitness questions accessible and understandable. Sabah Kadri is a Scientist by profession and a Certified Fitness Trainer who has been helping people lose weight and get fitter through her Youtube channel @workoutwithsabah for over 3 years. Sign up with me here: https://pages.sabahkadri.com

title: Old Testament Outtakes
author: Mike and Shane Versus
description: The podcast where ancient stories meet modern laughs without compromising the message! We look at old testament stories like Jonah with deeper lenses and some comical takes on the classical Bible stories.
